About this video

Created by Maths by Zosiama. Question 2: If X and Y are two sets such that X∪Y has 28 elements, X has 13 elements and Y has 20 elements, how many elements does X∩Y have? Answer: n(X∩Y) = 5 elements.

Every frame is drawn in code on one canvas as a pure function of time (60 fps). No video models, stock footage, photos or AI images. Narration: Kokoro-82M voice (Apache-2.0), generated offline. Music and sound effects: synthesised in code. Fonts: Fredoka and Noto Sans Devanagari (SIL OFL 1.1), DejaVu Sans symbol subset (Bitstream Vera licence). MP4/WebM muxing: Mediabunny (MPL-2.0, source: github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny).
